_about: Terms kept in English on purpose: each source maps to itself. Curated union of a hand-written computer-vision list and the term names of Google's Machine Learning Glossary (developers.google.com/machine-learning/glossary), which is published under CC BY 4.0. Single generic words were dropped on purpose - keeping words like 'cost', 'depth' or 'baseline' in English damages ordinary prose. A third group (note "user-xlsx") comes from a hand-made spreadsheet and prescribes a Turkish wording instead of keeping the term in English; where the two disagreed, the English-keeping entry won.
